info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Weather Alerts Unsubscribe-v3-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Unsubscription API allows users to unsubscribe from weather alerts that they no longer wish to receive. Typically utilized by individuals and organizations tracking weather conditions, this operation ensures that users can manage their notification preferences effectively. By removing specific alert subscriptions, consumers can reduce unwanted notifications and optimize their alert settings. This API supports seamless integration into applications requiring user-controlled weather alert management.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to unsubscribe from receiving alerts. Once the unsubscribe action is successful, the user will no longer receive any notifications related to the specified alerts.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to unsubscribe a user from alert notifications. The payload must adhere to the defined schema for successful unsubscription.

DeleteWeatherAlertsUnsubscribeRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the DELETE operation to unsubscribe from alerts.

DeleteWeatherAlertsUnsubscribeResponse_2.title: Unsubscribe Response

status.description: Indicates whether the unsubscribe operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number for tracking the unsubscribe request.

resultId.description: A unique identifier for the result of the unsubscribe operation.

state.description: Current state of the unsubscribe operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the unsubscribe request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the unsubscribe operation.

audit.description: Information regarding the audit trail of the unsubscribe operation.

DeleteWeatherAlertsUnsubscribeResponse_2.description: Response schema for the unsubscribe operation.
